title: auth-callback: pre-registered users wrongly 403'd (shadowed err)
description: In handleAuthCallback, the email pre-registration linking block used 'doc, err := query.Next()' which shadowed the outer err. close_reason: Fixed in oauth.go: inner err no longer shadows outer; pre-registration linking now passes the authorization check.

title: Support selective SSE transport override via X-Mcp-Force-Sse header
description: Implement a selective downgrade option in McpMultiplexerHandler. At the very beginning of ServeHTTP in main.go, check if the request contains the 'X-Mcp-Force-Sse: true' header (or similar identifiable signature). If present, bypass Streamable HTTP routing and immediately route the request to sseHandler. This permits clients behind buffered environments (like Antigravity on Cloud Run / GFE) to force unbuffered SSE streaming and prevent connection timeouts/hangs, without breaking newer clients (such as OpenCode) that operate perfectly fine on Streamable HTTP without modification.
close_reason: Successfully implemented selective SSE downgrade via X-Mcp-Force-Sse header and updated README.md

title: Refactor: reorganise A2A skills into skills/ Go subpackage with injectable index
description:
Currently skill_*.go files live in package main alongside main.go/oauth.go, accessing lexiconIndex as a package global. As skill count grows (name-generate, translate, neologism) and l04.5 brings an injectable taskstore, the right structural moment is to extract skills into a skills/ Go subpackage. This is separate from the skills/ markdown directory (agent skill prompts) which stays put.

Proposed layout:
  main.go            — bootstrap + mux wiring only
  oauth.go           — stays in main (needs http.Handler types)
  a2a.go             — dispatcher, card, claimsInterceptor
  skills/            — NEW Go subpackage (not the markdown skills/ dir)
    skills.go        — shared types; LexiconSearcher interface; injectable deps struct
    name_generate.go
    translate.go
    neologism.go
  index/             — already a subpackage (no change)

The LexiconSearcher interface replaces the lexiconIndex global, making skills testable without loading the full 4.5MB dataset. The injectable deps struct also carries the genai.Client so translate/neologism don't need package-level clients.
design: Do this when l04.5 ships (Firestore taskstore also benefits from injection at the same time). Trigger: when there are 4+ skill files OR l04.5 is in progress, whichever comes first.
acceptance_criteria: go build + make test + golangci-lint 0 issues; skills/ subpackage has no import of package main; lexiconIndex injected via interface; existing tests pass unchanged; markdown skills/ directory untouched.
